title: A forradalom küszöbén: a Pilvax és a márciusi ifjak (A Country on the Eve of Revolution)
grammar: Evidential & Modal Particles in Reformist Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can tell what happened in Europe and in Hungary in the spring of 1848.
I can use an apposition, as in Széchenyi István, a legnagyobb magyar.
I can name the Pilvax café, Petőfi, Jókai and the date of the revolution.
I can use eight new words about the eve of the revolution.
